paragraphs: LeoSight describes a unified command platform that connects law enforcement, fire, EMS, and emergency management across jurisdictions. The platform integrates CAD, cameras, ALPR, drones/DFR, gunshot acoustic detection, and field systems into one connected operational network. A second function covers cross-agency communication and shared workflows, from the initial call through investigation and case closure.

The technology was originally developed under the Live Earth brand to support special operations forces. That capability now powers a suite of solutions purpose-built for law enforcement, fire, rescue, and emergency response teams.

Rollout is described as learning an agency's systems and external agency collaborators, configuring integrations including CAD, AVL, LPR, RMS, VMS, and DFR, then launch, training, and continuing support. Agencies building a command center and agencies just getting started are both named, across law enforcement, fire, EMS, and emergency services.

quote.text: Whether you're building a command center or responding in the field, LeoSight helps you see more, share faster, and act with confidence.
